description: Update workspace brand settings. The designSpec field is a Markdown DESIGN.md document fed into AI generation system prompts; use it to encode voice, do/don't lists, and visual rules. companyName/websiteUrl/companyAddress also fill the matching merge tags in templates.

apiKey.description: Send16 API key (overrides SEND16_API_KEY env var)

companyAddress.description: Physical postal address. Fills {{companyAddress}} and is appended to the unsubscribe footer on campaigns lacking one; required by anti-spam law in several markets.

designSpec.description: Markdown DESIGN.md spec for AI generation
